current.summary: L-shaped kitchen, largely fitted. Base units in a deep teal-green with raised-panel doors and a glossy dark walnut-effect worktop. Sink run: black inset sink with black pull-out tap, slim dishwasher, grey-green metro-tile splashback finished with a brass trim, dark charcoal glazed wall cabinets with an open shelf below. Hob run: 4-burner gas hob, built-in stainless oven, black chimney hood, splashback in square pale-green tiles with brass trim. A wooden window to the front sits over the corner of the worktop. An arched opening beside the hob is currently covered with a black sheet. Oak-tone glazed double doors lead to the back terrace. Floor: large light-grey stone-effect tiles with matching tile skirting. Recessed ceiling downlights. The far end opens to the fridge & utility room and the bathroom door.
keep: Teal-green units, walnut-effect worktop, black sink and tap
Both tiled splashbacks with their brass trims
issues: Walls: patched plaster in many places, unpainted — around the terrace doors, the utility end, the arch and above the splashbacks
Ceiling: holes, cracks radiating from the downlights, old fixing points — fill, skim, paint
Loose coil of cable hanging at the ceiling near the hood; open junction box with wires beside the terrace doors; open hole high on the wall at the utility end
Front window: frame and reveal unfinished (raw timber / exposed edges) — needs finishing or replacing
Arched opening covered with a black sheet — what is it to become? (door, curtain, open arch, cupboard?)
End panel of the hob run is unfinished (raw edge with trim)
Wall cabinets are charcoal, units are teal — intended, or to be unified?
Terrace doors sit above floor level with a raw sill/threshold inside

target.concept: DRAFT, pending your job list — the kitchen itself is done; the room around it is not. Target: smooth finished walls and ceiling in warm white, electrics made safe and tidied, the front window finished, the arch resolved, and the unit end panel closed off. No change to units, worktop, tiles or appliances.
